$schema_note: LISBON-PORTO-VENUE-ESTATE-01 — a broad, venue-first research sweep across Lisboa, Porto, and immediately-adjacent Greater Lisbon/Greater Porto municipalities already treated as part of this project's proof (2026-08-24). Distinct from prior source-first research (BOTM-RESEARCH-LISBON-SOURCES-01, BOTM-RESEARCH-PORTO-SOURCES-01): this file starts from 'what real live-music venues exist' rather than 'what event feeds exist'. Every entry is a RESEARCH record — it does not by itself change ingestion or canonical venue data. Where an entry's evidence was judged strong enough to admit as a canonical Venue during this same package, existing_canonical_venue_id names the new (or pre-existing) venues/{lisbon,porto}.json entry — see docs/LISBON_PORTO_VENUE_ESTATE_01.md for the full methodology and the admission decisions.
